contentEn:
Reno Stars has managed hundreds of kitchen renovations across Metro Vancouver. The shortest kitchen reno we completed in 2025 took 12 days; the longest luxury job ran 26 weeks. Here is what actually drives that range — and what each scope looks like in real weeks.

How Long Does Each Kitchen Renovation Take in Vancouver?

Vancouver kitchen renovation timelines in 2026 break into four distinct scopes:

  • Cosmetic refresh (no layout change): 2–4 weeks
  • Mid-range full reno (10–14 linear ft cabinets, no structural work): 6–10 weeks
  • Premium reno (layout change, custom cabinets, appliance package): 10–16 weeks
  • Luxury gut (open-concept, designer brands, structural work): 16–28 weeks

A cosmetic refresh keeps your existing cabinets and plumbing rough-in — trades finish faster because there is no demo or rewiring. A mid-range reno rips everything to the studs, reruns electrical and plumbing, and installs new semi-custom cabinets and quartz — the single biggest variable is cabinet lead time (4–6 weeks for Canadian-built semi-custom). Premium and luxury scopes add structural changes, custom millwork, and high-end appliance sourcing that individually add weeks.

What Actually Extends a Kitchen Timeline in Vancouver

Five factors routinely push Vancouver kitchen timelines past the baseline estimates above:

  • Cabinet lead time: Canadian-built semi-custom cabinets take 4–6 weeks after measurements are confirmed. Custom local millwork runs 8–14 weeks. Order early in the project.
  • Structural wall removal: Removing a load-bearing wall requires an engineer assessment, LVL beam fabrication, and a building permit from the City of Vancouver or your municipality. Structure documents alone add 2–4 weeks.
  • Asbestos testing (pre-1990 homes): BC Building Code requires asbestos testing before demo in homes built before 1990. If found, remediation adds 1–3 weeks and must be done by a licensed contractor.
  • Strata condos and townhouses: Work hours are restricted by building rules (typically 9 am–5 pm weekdays), elevator booking is required, and dust protection must be in place. Budget an extra week for strata-managed interior work.
  • 200-amp panel upgrade: Adding an induction cooktop or electric oven often requires a panel upgrade, coordinated with BC Hydro — that single step can add 2–4 weeks of permit wait time.

The Vancouver Kitchen Renovation Step-by-Step Process

Here is the sequence a mid-range Vancouver kitchen renovation follows:

  • Weeks 1–2: On-site assessment, 3D design, material selection, permit application (if required)
  • Weeks 2–3: Cabinet measurements confirmed; order placed with manufacturer
  • Weeks 3–4: Demo — flooring, old cabinets, countertops, rough-in cut-offs
  • Weeks 4–5: Electrical and plumbing rough-in; structural work completed and inspected
  • Weeks 5–8: Cabinet installation (typically 3–5 days), countertop template and fabrication (1–2 weeks), tile backsplash installation
  • Weeks 8–10: Countertop installation, sink and faucet set, appliance connections, final electrical (under-cabinet lighting, outlets), painting, final clean
  • Week 10: Final walkthrough, BC Building Code inspection passed, warranty registered

How Municipality Affects Vancouver Kitchen Timeline

Permit wait times vary across Metro Vancouver municipalities:

  • Vancouver: Structural permits typically 3–5 weeks; minor work qualifies for fast-track
  • Burnaby / New Westminster: Structural permits 2–4 weeks
  • Coquitlam / Port Moody: 3–4 weeks; online submissions speed things up
  • Richmond: Most kitchen projects 2–3 weeks; strata buildings require additional council approval
  • North Vancouver / West Vancouver: 3–5 weeks; heritage considerations in some neighbourhoods
  • Surrey: 2–4 weeks for most kitchen permits; larger projects may require development permit

Vancouver Kitchen Renovation Cost by Scope

Timeline and budget are directly linked for kitchen renovations in Vancouver:

  • Cosmetic refresh ($25,000–$45,000): 2–4 weeks. Cabinet refinishing, new countertop, updated faucet and lighting.
  • Mid-range full reno ($45,000–$75,000): 6–10 weeks. All new semi-custom cabinets, quartz countertop, new appliances, tile backsplash, flooring.
  • Premium reno ($75,000–$110,000): 10–16 weeks. Custom cabinets, natural stone countertop, layout change, high-end appliance package (Wolf, Sub-Zero, Miele).
  • Luxury gut ($110,000–$160,000+): 16–28 weeks. Open-concept structural change, custom millwork, premium appliance package, designer fixtures, possible pantry addition.

Frequently Asked Questions About Kitchen Renovation in Vancouver

How long does a basic kitchen renovation take in Vancouver?

A cosmetic kitchen refresh — swapping cabinet doors, updating the faucet, and repainting — takes 2–4 weeks in Vancouver. A full mid-range kitchen renovation with new cabinets and appliances typically takes 6–10 weeks from first demo day to final walkthrough.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in Vancouver?

You need an electrical permit if you are moving outlets, adding circuits, or upgrading to an induction cooktop. You need a building permit if you are removing a wall, changing the window or door openings, or altering the plumbing layout. Cosmetic work — repainting, swapping cabinet hardware, installing a new faucet — requires no permit. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard contract.

Can I live in my home during a kitchen renovation?

Yes for a main-floor kitchen. Set up a temporary kitchen in the dining room or basement with a bar fridge, microwave, and hot plate. Do not expect to cook full meals for weeks 3–8 of a mid-range or larger project. If only one bathroom is being renovated at the same time, coordinate the schedule carefully with your contractor.

What is the biggest cause of kitchen renovation delays in Vancouver?

Cabinet lead time. Once demo is done, you are waiting for cabinets. Canadian-built semi-custom cabinets take 4–6 weeks from measurement confirmation. Custom local millwork takes 8–14 weeks. Reno Stars orders cabinets immediately after measurements are confirmed to minimise this gap.

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Cosmetic refresh: $25,000–$45,000. Mid-range full reno: $45,000–$75,000. Premium: $75,000–$110,000. Luxury gut: $110,000–$160,000+. All prices from actual Reno Stars contracts in Metro Vancouver, adjusted for 2026 labour and material rates.

温哥华各类型厨房改造需要多长时间？

2026年温哥华厨房改造工期分为四个层级：

  • 基础刷新（不改动布局）：2–4 周
  • 中档全面翻新（10–14 延尺柜体，无结构工程）：6–10 周
  • 高档翻新（布局改动、定制柜体、高端设备）：10–16 周
  • 豪华全面改造（开放式设计、设计师品牌、结构工程）：16–28 周

基础刷新保留现有柜体和管线预留口——因无拆建或线路重铺，工程进度更快。中档翻新则需拆除至结构层，重新铺设电线和水管，并安装新的半定制柜体和石英石——最大变数是柜体交货期（加拿大制造的半定制柜体需 4–6 周）。高档和豪华项目涉及结构改动、定制木作和高端电器采购，每项都会单独增加工期。

什么因素会延长温哥华厨房改造工期

以下五个因素经常使温哥华厨房改造工期超出基本预期：

  • 柜体交货期：加拿大制造的半定制柜体在尺寸确认后需 4–6 周交货。本地定制木作需 8–14 周。请在项目初期提前下单。
  • 拆除承重墙：拆除承重墙需工程师评估、LVL 横梁制作，以及温哥华市或所属市政府建筑许可。仅结构文件准备就需额外 2–4 周。
  • 1990 年前房屋的石棉检测：BC 省建筑规范要求 1990 年前建造的房屋在拆建前必须进行石棉检测。如发现石棉，处理需额外 1–3 周，且必须由持证承包商进行。
  • 共管公寓及联排别墅：施工时间受制于大楼规定（通常为工作日上午 9 点至下午 5 点），需预约货梯，并实行防尘保护。预算室内工程额外增加一周。
  • 200 安培电箱升级：新增电磁炉或电烤箱通常需要电箱升级，并与 BC Hydro 协调——仅此一项就可能增加 2–4 周的许可等待时间。

温哥华厨房改造工序流程

中档温哥华厨房改造遵循以下标准工序：

  • 第 1–2 周：上门评估、3D 效果图制作、建材选择、许可申请（如果需要）
  • 第 2–3 周：柜体尺寸确认；下单至制造商
  • 第 3–4 周：拆建——地板、旧柜体拆除、台面拆除、线路预留口切断
  • 第 4–5 周：水电管线安装；结构工程完成并通过验收
  • 第 5–8 周：柜体安装（通常 3–5 天）、台面量尺及制作（ 1–2 周）、瓷砖背面安装
  • 第 8–10 周：台面安装、水槽和龙头安装、电器接驳、最终电工（柜下照明、插座）、喷漆、最终清洁
  • 第 10 周：竣工验收、BC 省建筑检验合格、质保登记完成

大温各城市对装修工期的影响

大温各城市的许可证审批时间有所不同：

  • 温哥华：结构许可通常需 3–5 周；小额工程可申请快速通道
  • 本拿比 / 满地可：结构许可 2–4 周
  • 高贵林 / 满地可：3–4 周；电子递交可加快进度
  • 列治文：大多数厨房项目 2–3 周；城市屋建筑需额外业委会批准
  • 北温哥华 / 西温哥华：3–5 周；部分社区需考虑文物保护
  • 萨里：大多数厨房许可 2–4 周；大型项目可能需要开发许可

温哥华厨房改造费用明细

工期和预算在温哥华厨房装修中直接相关：

  • 基础刷新（$25,000–$45,000）：2–4 周。柜体刷新、新台面、更新龙头和照明。
  • 中档全面翻新（$45,000–$75,000）：6–10 周。全新的半定制柜体、石英台面、新电器、瓷砖背面、地面。
  • 高档翻新（$75,000–$110,000）：10–16 周。定制柜体、天然石台面、布局改动、高端电器套餐（Wolf、Sub-Zero、Miele）。
  • 豪华全面改造（$110,000–$160,000+）：16–28 周。开放式结构改动、定制木作、高端电器套餐、设计师洁具，可能增加食品储藏室。

关于温哥华厨房装修的常见问题

温哥华基础厨房装修需要多长时间？

表面翻新——更换柜门、更新龙头和刷漆——在温哥华需 2–4 周。全面中档厨房装修配备新柜体和电器，从第一次拆建到最终验收通常需 6–10 周。

温哥华厨房装修需要许可吗？

移动插座、增加电路或升级至电磁炉需要电气许可。拆除墙体、改变窗户或门洞、或改动水管布局需要建筑许可。表面工程——刷漆、更换柜体硬件、安装新龙头——无需许可。聚星装修作为标准合同的一部分处理所有许可申请。

厨房装修期间我可以住在家里吗？

可以，如果是主层厨房。在餐厅或地下室设置临时厨房，配一台吧台冰箱、微波炉和电磁炉。中档或更大规模项目的第 3–8 周不要指望能做大餐。如果同时只装修一个卫生间，请与装修公司仔细协调时间表。

温哥华厨房装修延误的最主要原因是什么？

柜体交货期。一旦拆建完成，您就在等柜体。加拿大制造的半定制柜体从尺寸确认起需 4–6 周。定制本地木作需 8–14 周。聚星装修在尺寸确认后立即下单，以最大程度减少等待时间。

2026 年温哥华厨房装修费用是多少？

基础刷新：$25,000–$45,000。中档全面翻新：$45,000–$75,000。高档：$75,000–$110,000。豪华全面改造：$110,000–$160,000+。以上所有价格均来自聚星装修在大温哥华的实际合同，已按 2026 年人工和材料费率调整。
